title: TCP Selective Acknowledgment Options
summary: Proposes selective acknowledgment options for TCP, letting a receiver say exactly which blocks of data arrived out of order. A sender can then resend only what is missing instead of everything after a gap.

eli5.summary: If a friend says they got pages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9, you only resend page 6. SACK lets TCP say what is missing.

questions: how does tcp know which packets were lost
